title: Evict stale database connections before async Replay Vision activities
answers: Why do observations permanently miss thumbnails after a database connection drops?
Where should async Replay Vision activities clean up stale Django connections?
Why does increasing activity retries fail to recover a dead connection?
body:
Symptom: An observation can permanently lack a thumbnail after a database connection drops.
Root cause: products/replay_vision/backend/temporal/decorators.py:track_activity previously evicted stale connections only before synchronous activities; async ORM work reused a long-lived thread with dead connections.
Fix pattern: In the shared async activity wrapper, await sync_to_async(close_stale_db_connections)() before invoking the activity, so cleanup covers every decorated async activity.
Constraints: Skip eviction under settings.TEST because it touches Django connections in tests without database access. This addresses stale connections; increasing retries alone does not resolve them, and this is not a strategy for multi-minute database outages.
applies: Async Replay Vision activities wrapped by track_activity, especially activities using Django ORM calls.
